_provenance.title: CROSS-MORSE: Cross-Spectral Control of Message Passing in Frozen Graph Neural Networks
_provenance.transcription_rule: Protocol constants and reporting targets transcribed from the identified manuscript sources; execution choices are documented in IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md.
_provenance.scope: Registered constants, thresholds, grids and backbone settings from the manuscript; released_full_profiles records independently instantiated source-model counts. Companion file: reported_results.json.

additional_registrations.scope: Printed protocol descriptions, declared reference accounting ranges and an analytical grid. These are not measured observations or substitutes for original execution records. The exact numerical o_dec and phi_OL inputs are not printed and remain unspecified.

data_roles_table_S2.D_admit: official validation split (untouched by any decision that fixes the policy; also labelled calibration split in the supplementary text)
data_roles_table_S2.internal_checkpoint_validation: an internal D_fit validation subset; never reuses D_admit
data_roles_table_S2.roman_empire_repeats: the procedure is repeated over the ten official splits

multi_graph_units.COCO-SP: complete graphs; official training 113286; D_confirm 5664; D_compare 5665; independent admission J = 5000; test 5000
multi_graph_units.Peptides-func: complete graphs; official training 10873; D_confirm 544; D_compare 544; independent admission J = 2331; test 2331

data_roles_table_S2.D_compare: Reserved 5% of official training for E3-E6 comparisons, disjoint from confirmation and admission; never changes the deployed policy.
data_roles_table_S2.current_protocol_note: Current SI Table S2 separates five training roles (60/20/10/5/5). Confirmation fixes the policy before untouched validation admission; D_compare is an independent diagnostic comparison set. Transcription alone does not prove the executed masks were disjoint.

gates.nominal graph value: U(Delta_plant) < -0.004 nats; failure: stop or improve plant
gates.depth qualification: PDD <= 1.0 pp and DIL gap <= 0.020 nats; failure: do not credit controller with plant rescue
gates.registry support: phi_registry >= 0.80 and selected strata = 1.00; failure: prune bank or collect exploration
gates.residual headroom: U(Delta_oracle) < -0.003 nats; failure: retain strongest open loop

entry_contract_eq5_table_S3.log_depth_grid_loss_eq6: DIL_log d = (1/log2(d_K/d_1)) sum_j (l_{d_j}+l_{d_{j+1}})/2 (log2 d_{j+1} - log2 d_j) on a geometric depth grid

support_eq7.ESS_definition: (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 on one weight vector per (stratum, action) cell
support_eq7.identity: ESS >= 64 implies omega_max <= 0.125, so omega_max_star = 0.20 is nonbinding on the same cells (Table S18)

transport_adapter_eq8_eq10.common_action: a = (rho, nu, alpha, m): w = (1-rho) e_N + rho w~(m); T = (1-nu) I + nu sum_m w_m K~_m; G_{l+1} = phi(T H W + b); H_{l+1} = LN[(1-alpha) G_{l+1} + alpha H^ref]
transport_adapter_eq8_eq10.resolvent_eq9: K~_{eta,T} = eta sum_{t=0}^{T} (1-eta)^t P^t + (1-eta)^{T+1} I; registered truncation order T = 8; T sparse products per step when powers are formed on line
transport_adapter_eq8_eq10.executed_range_eq10: h_bar_a = nu_a[(1-rho_a) + rho_a sum_{t=0}^{T} t eta_a (1-eta_a)^t]
transport_adapter_eq8_eq10.identity_quantities: identity mass (1-eta)^{T+1}; executed identity coefficient (1-nu) + nu rho [eta + (1-eta)^{T+1}]
transport_adapter_eq8_eq10.inserted_site_form: V_a(H, R) = (1-tau_a) H + tau_a[(1-alpha_a) T_a H + alpha_a R], tau_A0 = 0 (literal bypass), (tau_a, alpha_a, T_a) = (nu_a, alpha_a, (1-rho_a) P + rho_a K~_{eta_a, T})

actions.interpretation: longer range with lower transport; at T = 8 nearly half of the kernel's row mass stays on its diagonal, and the executed operator has identity coefficient 0.57

sensing_eq11_table_S8.windows: degree-8 Chebyshev polynomial windows G_b = g_b(L) on L_sym; six fixed windows, three retained bands; band definitions selected inside training folds then frozen
sensing_eq11_table_S8.source_alignment: c_lb = <G_b H_l, G_b H_0>_F / (||G_b H_l||_F ||G_b H_0||_F + eps)
measurement_vector: transport history (accumulated mass, expected range, relative depth)
sensing_eq11_table_S8.sensing_cost_identity: 8 r/(1+r) of a nominal step per sensed site with full-state degree-8 sensing, r = E/(N d) the sparse-to-dense ratio; r = 0.013 (arxiv), 0.583 (proteins), 0.049 (products), 0.004 (Roman), 0.044 (Pascal, COCO), 0.016 (Peptides)
sensing_eq11_table_S8.reduced_sensor: The reported executed profiles are (k, P_s) = (32,4) on proteins and (64,2) on Pascal; k = 0 denotes full-state sensing elsewhere. Observer cadence is separate. A Gaussian sketch gives the stated band-power relative SD bound sqrt(2/k).
sensing_eq11_table_S8.observer_diagnostics: innovation and NIS are observer diagnostics, not measurement-vector coordinates
sensing_eq11_table_S8.acquisition_contract: Cheap support features update every site. Spectral power/alignment cache between acquisitions; reach is recomputed from cached powers for the next nominal operator and zero at terminal depth. Add spectral age when P_s > 1. Cached measurements are not certificates.

observer_eq12_table_S9.validation: normalized innovation squared, innovation bias and whiteness
observer_eq12_table_S9.action_critic: 128-128-64 SiLU multilayer perceptron with dropout 0.10 and mean/log-scale heads
observer_eq12_table_S9.sequence_models: transition, stage-cost and terminal-value models: two-layer 128-dimensional residual networks
observer_eq12_table_S9.training: AdamW 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, batch 512, 200 epochs, patience 20; cross-fitted by complete trajectories; calibrated on the action or sequence actually selected
observer_eq12_table_S9.deterministic_ties: lower complexity, smaller E, lower compute, configuration hash
observer_eq12_table_S9.critic_target_eq13: Delta_{l,h}(a) = E[l_{l+h}(a -> pi_N) - l_{l+h}(pi_N) | I_l]; h = 1 for one-action models
observer_eq12_table_S9.training_source_status: Training hyperparameters are retained implementation configuration; actual run manifest and source identity govern reproducibility. Do not infer a completed training run from these constants.

policy_families_eq15_table_S10.radius_score_eq16: pi_radius(s_l) = argmin_{a in A_sup(s_l)} [mu^(a) + kappa sigma^(a) + r_conf(a) + r_op(a) + lambda_rho c_rho(a)]
policy_families_eq15_table_S10.sequence_objective_eq17: J_H = sum_{h=0}^{H-1} gamma^h [c^_{l+h} + kappa sigma^_{l+h} + lambda_rho c_rho(a_{l+h}) + lambda_T c_T(a_{l+h})] + gamma^H lambda_V V^_{l+H}
policy_families_eq15_table_S10.mpc_ol: solves Eq. (17) once at l = 0 and executes the sequence unchanged
policy_families_eq15_table_S10.mpc_rh: re-solves at every depth and executes the first action

selection_eq19_algorithm_S4.rule: Q_s = {q in Q_feas : U_s(q) < -epsilon_R, U_s(q) <= U_min + epsilon_eq}; q^_s = q_C if Q_s empty, else lexicographic argmin over complexity C(q)
selection_eq19_algorithm_S4.intervals: paired cluster max-t bootstrap with comparator reconstruction inside every resample; [L_s, U_s] = Delta^_s(q) -/+ r_s(q)

radius.fail_output: one-step if one-step in Q_s, otherwise q_C

MPC-RH.fail_output: MPC-OL if MPC-OL in Q_s, otherwise q_C

confirmation_eq20_table_S11.holm_family: nine prespecified mechanism contrasts across datasets, Holm-adjusted at level 0.05 (Supplementary Table S14)
confirmation_eq20_table_S11.margin_rule: A retained mechanism must pass the prespecified Holm-adjusted 0.05 test against zero and exceed the practical margin in the beneficial direction at the held-out point estimate. Equality at the margin chooses the simpler output. A small P against zero alone does not establish the practical margin.

admission_eq27_theorem2_table_S13.bound: U_a = D_bar + sqrt(2 S^2 log(2/delta_a)/J) + 14 B log(2/delta_a)/(3 (J-1)); admit iff U_a <= -epsilon_a and the metric gate holds
admission_eq27_theorem2_table_S13.single_graph_rule: descriptive clipped-loss cluster bootstrap over the buffered cores (arxiv, proteins, products) or paired small-sample interval over the ten official splits (Roman-empire): pass when D_bar <= -epsilon_a, U_desc < 0 and the metric gate holds; no coverage statement

statistical_tests.mechanism_contrasts: one Holm family of nine contrasts at 0.05; equivalence claims use two one-sided tests at the prespecified margin
statistical_tests.roman_empire: paired small-sample interval over ten official splits
statistical_tests.minimum_detectable_effect: 2.80 standard errors at two-sided 0.05 and 3.34 at the first Holm step alpha/4
statistical_tests.budget_matched_arms: E3-E6 evaluated on reserved D_compare against frozen qM under a common expected-work ceiling; one Holm family of four contrasts per dataset; independent confirmation on D_confirm precedes comparison.

arms.E3: initial-input schedule predictor (network of the critic's parameter count, decodes a supported sequence from pooled H_0 and graph statistics)
arms.E4: initial-input distillation of the feedback policy
arms.E5: no-observation replanning on model-predicted states with the same model calls as MPC-RH
arms.E6: budget-aware rule q_B with the selective-sensing certificate tau_l = max(0.002, 2 L_J r_l)

budget_matched_comparison_section4_table.decision_boundary_proposition10: the initial-input predictor is the better deployment iff phi_x^gain > 1 (against the fully observed rule) or > r_B (against the budget-aware rule) under the contract; priced work: feedback preferable iff lambda < lambda*_pred
budget_matched_comparison_section4_table.implementation_scope: SI p7 explicitly distinguishes formal branch-complete Algorithm S3 from bounded model-call planning with scheduled acquisition in the accompanying runtime; every E6 result must name its executable variant.

deployment_economics_definition2.exchange_rate: lambda* = |Delta| / (E C(q_D) - E C(q_C)) in nats per nominal execution of added work
deployment_economics_definition2.amortization: M* = 3600 C_qual / [theta (E C(q_D) - E C(q_C)) t_nom] served inputs at tolerated share theta = 0.1

ogbn-arxiv.architecture: MLP4-512 encoder; post-training adapter at the native aggregation call; softmax head
ogbn-arxiv.optimizer: AdamW 3e-4, weight decay 1e-4, cosine; 500 epochs, patience 50
ogbn-arxiv.native_call: shared-weight propagation step after the encoder; l indexes the 256 unrolled applications

ogbn-proteins.architecture: MLP4-512 with edge-feature aggregation; adapter at the native aggregation call; sigmoid mean-BCE head
ogbn-proteins.optimizer: AdamW 2e-4, weight decay 1e-5, cosine; 400 epochs, patience 40
ogbn-proteins.native_call: edge-weighted propagation step; edge features enter the kernel weights; 128 unrolled steps

ogbn-products.architecture: scalable MLP3-512; exact full-graph sparse propagation with dense calls chunked at 65536 rows; softmax head
ogbn-products.backbone_family: shared transport plant with full-graph sparse propagation
ogbn-products.optimizer: AdamW 5e-4, weight decay 1e-5, cosine; batch 65,536; 300 epochs, patience 30
ogbn-products.native_call: full-graph sparse propagation at every step; only dense calls chunk at 65536 rows; 64 unrolled steps

Roman-empire.architecture: heterophily encoder4-384; adapter at the native aggregation call; softmax head
Roman-empire.checkpoint_rule: minimum internal-Dfit validation CE per split
Roman-empire.native_call: heterophily-aware propagation step: ego and neighbour representations enter the native update separately; 256 unrolled steps

PascalVOC-SP.architecture: GraphGPS-style 6x128 backbone; frozen then post-training instrumented; softmax head
PascalVOC-SP.backbone_family: GPS-style plant: 6 native local-MPNN sites plus 122 inserted parameter-free control sites
PascalVOC-SP.optimizer: AdamW 5e-4, weight decay 1e-5; batch 32; 300 epochs, patience 30
PascalVOC-SP.native_call: local MPNN branch of each GPS block; global-attention branch untouched; 128 controlled transport sites = 21 sub-steps per native block plus 2 boundary sites

COCO-SP.architecture: GraphGPS-style 6x128 backbone; frozen then post-training instrumented; softmax head
COCO-SP.backbone_family: GPS-style plant: 6 native local-MPNN sites plus 122 inserted parameter-free control sites
COCO-SP.optimizer: AdamW 5e-4, weight decay 1e-5; batch 32; 300 epochs, patience 30

Peptides-func.architecture: GINE-style 8x128 backbone with degree-normalized linear aggregation (edge features as nonnegative scalar edge weights); frozen then post-training instrumented; sigmoid AP head
Peptides-func.backbone_family: linear-GINE-style plant: 8 native sites plus 56 inserted parameter-free control sites
Peptides-func.optimizer: AdamW 1e-3, weight decay 1e-5; batch 128; 250 epochs, patience 30
Peptides-func.checkpoint_rule: maximum internal-Dfit validation AP with BCE tie-break; 12 seeds
Peptides-func.native_call: degree-normalized linear aggregation of the trained plant; the standard nonlinear GINE message is not used; 64 controlled transport sites = 8 sub-steps per native layer

qualification_cost_table_S41.accounting_note: Stage allocation shares and multipliers follow the source. E3-E6 is a separate campaign; scheduler records distinguish per-seed, HPO and total GPU-hours.

requirements: intermediate node representations readable through standard runtime hooks
aggregation call wrappable as a nonnegative row-normalizable linear operator with coefficients independent of the current hidden state
native update U_l, learned parameters, numerical precision, nominal execution and prediction head unchanged; U_l Lipschitz in its message argument
covered: local message-passing branch of hybrid local-global models (GraphGPS-style)
GPR-GNN through its nonnegative per-step propagation P
excluded: fused kernels that expose no hook
state-dependent kernels such as attention weights
edge-conditioned nonlinear messages such as the standard GINE message

backbones_source_status.execution_identity: train/model_inventory.json, sealed checkpoint hashes and runtime source identity
backbones_source_status.parity: requires archived architecture, checkpoint inventory and source identity
backbones_source_status.count_scope: One instantiated predictor: encoder, native updates and prediction head; separate controller parameters and ensemble/seed/depth multiplication excluded. All parameter elements are counted even when frozen; buffers are reported separately.
backbones_source_status.reported_count_scope: The parameters_M values in backbones_table_S5 are the manuscript's benchmark-plant counts at the printed precision; every released full profile instantiates a plant whose exact count agrees with its Table S5 value at that precision (make model-inventory, make registry-check).

default_width_plant.scope: Table S5d, released default configuration: the arxiv plant built with the default widths (encoder width equal to the hidden width, linear head) at 128 inputs and 40 outputs; scripts/model_inventory.py --default-widths instantiates it.

width_keys.encoder_hidden: width of the encoder's hidden layers (transport plants); the last encoder layer outputs hidden_dim
width_keys.head_hidden: hidden width of a two-layer prediction head; 0 selects a linear head
width_keys.feedforward_hidden: feed-forward hidden width of each GPS block
width_keys.block_mlp_hidden: hidden width of the update MLP of each linear-GINE block
width_keys.block_mlp_layers: two- or three-layer update MLP of each linear-GINE block

dataset_statistics_table_S6c_S23b._scope: Published dataset statistics used in the Table S6c and S23b propagation estimates, with hidden width d and controlled depth L from Table S5. E retains each provider's reported edge convention; it is not a uniform undirected-pair count or the runtime operator's post-processing adjacency count. These identities do not measure execution work, encoder/head costs or elapsed time.

identities.sparse_to_dense_ratio_r: E / (N d), printed to three decimals in Table S6c
identities.full_state_sensing_share: 8 r / (1 + r) of one nominal step for degree-8 sensing at every site; halved at P_s = 2
identities.residual: m - 1 - 8 r / (1 + r) with the per-member multiplier m of Table S23 (full-state sensing at every site)
identities.admissible_sketch_ratio: min(1, (m - 1) / (8 r / (1 + r))), the largest (k/d)/P_s compatible with m
identities.W_nom: L (N d^2 + E d), the paper's propagation-work estimate using published edge counts (Table S23b prints arxiv, proteins and Roman); not a measurement of total runtime operations
